title: BIST-ITCH: several fixes and white space cleanup
description:
* Include wireshark.h rather than individual header files
* Remove superfluous initializer
* Simplify tailing bytes dissection
* Add missing header field

And cleanup white space to create consistent code appearance.

Sample capture, as distributed via Discord: [moldudp3000sample.pcap](/uploads/013745a85720beee77984dc4319b136f/moldudp3000sample.pcap)  
Use Decode as: UDP port 21001-21006 as MoldUDP64 and MoldUDP64 data as BIST-ITCH

notes.body: I am sympathetic to explicitly setting a boolean preference.  Its not unset, its false.
LGTM, only gripe was the bool preference.
